units.source_text: 正在此时，忽闻侍女报道：萤兵部卿亲王驾到。

en.t: Just then, a maid suddenly announced that His Highness Prince Hotaru, Captain of the Ministry of War, had arrived.

units.source_text: 源氏吃了一惊，连忙穿上常礼服，又命添设蒲团，延请亲王入室。

en.t: Genji was startled, hurriedly put on his formal everyday robes, ordered extra cushions to be set out, and invited the prince into the room.

units.source_text: 这位亲王风度亦甚清秀，拾级升阶，从容不迫。

en.t: This prince, too, had a very refined and graceful bearing, and he ascended the steps calmly and unhurriedly.
All the ladies in waiting peered out from behind the blinds.

units.source_text: 两人相见，互道寒暄，礼貌恭谨，态度优雅。

en.t: When the two men met, they exchanged courteous greetings with respectful manners and elegant composure.

units.source_text: 源氏向他表示欢迎：“近日无事闲居，不堪寂寞之苦。

en.t: Genji welcomed him, saying, "These days I have been living idly with nothing to do, and the loneliness has been hard to bear.
Your gracious visit has come at exactly the right time!"

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王便把源氏所嘱书的册子交奉。

en.t: Prince Hotaru, Captain of the Ministry of War, then presented the booklet that Genji had asked him to write.

units.source_text: 源氏立刻披览，但见书法虽非特别优越，然而页页清整，笔笔挺秀，诚不失为佳作。

en.t: Genji opened it at once and looked through it; although the calligraphy was not especially outstanding, every page was neat and clear, every stroke firm and elegant, and it was truly a fine work.

units.source_text: 诗歌亦甚别致，故意选取富有特色的古歌。

en.t: The poems were also highly distinctive, deliberately chosen from old poems with marked character.

units.source_text: 每首不过三行，汉字极少，体裁风流潇洒。

en.t: Each poem took up no more than three lines, used very few Chinese characters, and had a stylish, graceful form.

units.source_text: 源氏惊叹道：“大作如此高明，诚非始料所及，我等只有搁笔了！”

en.t: Genji exclaimed in admiration, "I never imagined your work would be so accomplished; the rest of us can only lay down our brushes!"

units.source_text: 亲王戏言答道：“我既腼颜参与群贤之列，拙作也就托福增光了。”

en.t: The prince answered jokingly, "Since I had the shamelessness to join the ranks of such worthy men, my poor work has borrowed some of their reflected glory."
